name: MSI PRO B850M-A WIFI PZ mATX Motherboard
shortDescription: MSI PRO B850M-A WIFI PZ mATX Motherboard (Project Zero Back-Connect Design / AMD Socket AM5 / Supports Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series / Dual Channel DDR5 / PCIe 5.0 M.2 & GPU Slot / Wi-Fi 7 & 2.5G LAN / Blueto
descriptionHtml:
MSI PRO B850M-A WIFI PZ mATX Motherboard (Project Zero Back-Connect Design / AMD Socket AM5 / Supports Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series / Dual Channel DDR5 / PCIe 5.0 M.2 & GPU Slot / Wi-Fi 7 & 2.5G LAN / Bluetooth 5.4 / 3 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Achieve an ultra-clean, cable-free internal aesthetic with the MSI PRO B850M-A WIFI PZ mATX motherboard, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 3-Year Local Agent Warranty. Featuring MSI revolutionary Project Zero (PZ) back-connect design, all power and data connectors are located on the rear of the board for seamless cable management. Engineered for AMD Socket AM5 supporting Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series processors, it combines high-speed DDR5 memory, PCIe 5.0 expansion, ultra-fast Wi-Fi 7, 2.5G Ethernet, and advanced thermal management for supreme stability and efficiency.
